subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Pivot to Streaming
description: Learn The Pivot to Streaming in one minute.

hook.text: In 2007, Netflix did something investors called insane—they launched a streaming service alongside their DVD business.

buildup.text: The streaming library was tiny at first. Most content was old movies and forgotten TV shows nobody wanted.

discovery.text: But broadband was spreading fast. As internet speeds grew, so did the appeal of instant, unlimited content.

twist.text: Netflix's own data showed that streaming customers watched more and canceled less than DVD subscribers.

climax.text: By 2011, Netflix had more streaming subscribers than DVD customers. The pivot was complete.

punchline.text: Netflix bet on the internet before the internet was ready.

quiz.question: When did Netflix launch its streaming service?
